section: Truepoint: six-month delivery of Zoom Rooms and the impact on staff, clients and room booking
body:
This part of the Truepoint case study covers how AVI-SPL delivered the collaboration spaces in Truepoint's new office and what Truepoint's people say changed afterwards. All outcomes are reported as statements from Truepoint and AVI-SPL staff; the page gives no measured figures.

**Delivery**
- The project had a six-month timeframe, which the page calls a challenge for everyone involved. AVI-SPL helped Truepoint meet its deadline with the results it expected.
- Truepoint Technology Specialist Brad Felix said what impressed him most was how calm and collected AVI-SPL was: when an issue came up, the team troubleshot it on the spot and made modifications.
- Steve Condon, President of Truepoint, said the design of the space reflects the firm's culture and its personal relationship with clients.

**Impact as stated**
- Felix says the company has seen a "huge productivity boost" since moving in.
- Condon says clients and guests have been very impressed and that the office is not what they expect from a financial advisory firm; he describes it as fresh, colorful and relaxed.
- Employee reaction is described as similarly positive. Condon notes excitement about everyone being back on one floor and says the workspaces have been welcomed by the team.
- The page says the mix of solutions and environment encourages team members to be forward-thinking and to live Truepoint values such as personalized attention to clients.

**Room booking**
- Before the move, staff struggled to find rooms for meetings.
- With the Crestron scheduling panels, staff now scan the office to see which rooms are free and then book their Zoom meetings.
- AVI-SPL Account Manager Steven Mason calls the Crestron scheduling panels a plug-and-play solution when paired with the Zoom Rooms calendar, and says Zoom Rooms has been very easy to use.

**Day-to-day use**
- The standardized solutions in the collaboration spaces support interaction with guests wherever they are located.
- Employees can video conference with clients to share advice, documents and presentations.
- Condon says his favorite part of the new office is the energy it has created, and that it has made daily life easier.

**When to use this**
For questions about what a customer experienced after a Zoom Rooms deployment, how scheduling panels help staff find rooms, or evidence that AVI-SPL can deliver a new office against a fixed deadline.

**Not stated in this source**
No quantified productivity, usage or adoption figures, and no costs.
